data.name: Mafaaz
data.gender_notes: Mafaaz is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'faaza', which means 'to go', 'to travel', 'to journey'. The name Mafaaz signifies a journey or a voyage, whether it be a physical one or a spiritual one. It suggests a sense of adventure and freedom, as well as the idea of exploring new territories and experiences. The name Mafaaz carries the meaning “Voyage, Travel” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mafaaz usually hope their child will grow to embody voyage, travel and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Encourages exploration of the self and the world, and the pursuit of knowledge and wisdom. It also symbolizes the journey of the soul towards the divine.
data.etymology: Mafaaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Voyage, Travel.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mafaaz total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
